description: Translate, rephrase, and correct text with DeepL

plugins.name: deepl
plugins.description: DeepL's MCP server gives Claude access to professional translation, rephrasing, and correction tools. Translate text between 30+ languages with industry-leading quality, rephrase text in different styles and tones, correct grammar and spelling, manage glossaries, translate documents, and more — all using the caller's DeepL seat entitlement via OAuth.
